protocol: A12 controlled packed-RAW motion mechanism diagnostic v1
scope: MIS20S1 A3 training-reference-derived constructed targets; development diagnostic, not independent real dynamic or cross-sensor validation
limitations: Targets inherit the static reference's residual error and scene overlap with A3 training.
Same-colour packed-plane integer shifts preserve CFA but do not simulate optical subpixel motion, motion blur or rolling shutter.
Moving-patch boundaries are artificial and are used to expose temporal averaging and disocclusion behaviour.
Two calibrated MIS20S1 noise levels do not represent other sensor noise distributions.
No pass/fail quality threshold is inferred from one scalar metric; fixed error vectors are reported per region.
